purpose: Teach: ひっくり返し/潰す/すこぶる/おち/のぼっ/戴き/なけりゃ/ばらつき

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが船をひっくり返して大笑いされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, my father flipped that boat and we all laughed for days.
lines.style: Quiet, measured nostalgia. Voice settles into the memory — not rushed. Slight smile in the words. Patient exhale between phrases, like time itself is moving slower.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ご自分の体を潰す事のないご性格でらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, he had such a way about him — never let himself get too wound up, did he, dear?
lines.style: Warm agreement, gentle correction beneath. Her voice picks up his thread and reweaves it into her own understanding. Soft, matter-of-fact. The lilt of an affectionate question at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはすこぶる頑健でらした
lines.en: Gran, he was remarkably strong back then. Built like iron, that man was.
lines.style: Voice settles deeper into the past. Admiring, almost reverent tone — not flowery, just factual respect. Steady rhythm. The words come as if seeing him again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご自分のおちにくいユーモアをお持ちでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He did have that dry wit of his, didn't he? The kind that sneaks up on you.
lines.style: Gentle affection in her voice. She's nodding slightly, remembering. Not laughing — something quieter. Recognition of a way of being. Warm and knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと山にのぼっていらした
lines.en: Gran, when he was alive, we'd climb that mountain together. Just the two of us.
lines.style: Voice tightens slightly around the memory. Slower pace here — the climb is in the words. Affection mixed with the weight of it being only memory now. Breathes after 'together.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お客様からたくさんお品を戴きましたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and people were always bringing gifts for him — everyone wanted to do him favours, didn't they?
lines.style: She's observing this fact with her own quiet appreciation. Voice has warmth and a hint of gentle mischief — she knows why people gave to him. Not boasting, just noticing aloud. Conversational, knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがいなけりゃ、生きていけなかったぞ
lines.en: Gran, if he hadn't been here, I don't know how I would have made it through.
lines.style: Deepest register. Quiet conviction — not performing sadness, just stating truth. Long pause before this. The words are plain, which makes them heavier. Voice doesn't waiver.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の成績にばらつきがあっても気にされなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You never worried about such things, did you? Whether the grandchildren did well or not. You just loved them.
lines.style: Her voice curves upward gently with affection and recognition. She's seeing something true about him — his easy grace with imperfection. Soft, certain. The question is rhetorical, warm. Trailing warmth at the end.
